narr: A rogue thunderstorm developed over Western portions of Madison County on the afternoon/evening of the 23rd. The thunderstorm remained nearly stationary for several hours, dumping prolific amounts of rainfall from the Indian Creek river gage West to neighborhoods along Zierdt Road (near Toyota Field/Trash Panda Stadium). Several instances of flash flooding occurred, with a few residents in the Mountain Brook neighborhood unable to leave/get into their houses due to the roadway being flooded with 8-12 of water.
ev: Madison Police Dept reported flooding of Hursthaven Court at Hursthaven Drive in the Mountain Brook neighborhood. Flood water was deep enough to block residents from entering their homes. Flooding also reported along Zierdt Road. Depth of water estimated at 6-12.
